data.name: StructuredLogs
data.comment: The Telemetry tab's page and list of a run's structured logs.

data.name: Traces
data.comment: The Telemetry tab's page and list of a run's traces.

data.name: SpanHierarchy
data.comment: The accessible name of the list of a trace's spans.

data.name: ShowLogTrace
data.value: Show the structured log's trace and span
data.comment: The logs page's button going to the chosen log's trace.

data.name: ShowSpanLogs
data.value: Show a retained log of this trace and span
data.comment: The traces page's button going to the chosen span's logs.

data.name: LogsStreamHere
data.value: Structured logs stream here while this page is shown.
data.comment: The logs page's words before anything is read.

data.name: TracesStreamHere
data.value: Traces stream here while this page is shown.
data.comment: The traces page's words before anything is read.

data.name: Connecting
data.comment: A page's words while it connects to the dashboard.

data.name: LiveTraces
data.comment: The traces page's words as they stream: how many the dashboard keeps.

data.name: LiveLogs
data.comment: The logs page's words as they stream: how many the dashboard keeps.

data.name: Ended
data.comment: A page's words once the dashboard's stream ended.

data.name: FailedReconnect
data.comment: A page's words once its read failed; {reason} says what failed.

data.name: NoDashboard
data.value: {run}'s dashboard is not up: it has no logs or traces to read
data.comment: Why a run's logs and traces cannot be read.

data.name: Unread
data.value: The dashboard's logs and traces could not be read: {reason}
data.comment: A failed read of a dashboard; {reason} is its own words, secrets masked.

data.name: NoProgram
data.value: {name} runs no .NET program on this machine to read metrics from
data.comment: The Stats page's words for a run with no .NET program here.

data.name: WaitingForMetrics
data.comment: The Stats page's words until the program's first readings come.

data.name: Failed
data.comment: The Stats page's words where reading the program's metrics failed.

data.name: WaitingForPort
data.value: Waiting for {name}'s runtime to open its diagnostic port…
data.comment: The Stats page's words while the program's runtime starts.

data.name: AskingAgain
data.comment: The Stats page's words where a read failed and is asked again.

data.name: EndedBefore
data.comment: The Stats page's words where the program ended before any reading.

data.name: EndedAfter
data.value: {name} ended: its metrics stop at its end
data.comment: The Stats page's words once the program ended.

data.name: NoneThisSecond
data.comment: A histogram's line for a second it measured nothing.

data.name: SentEverySecond
data.comment: The Stats page's words for metrics a source sends (a Godot game's monitors).

data.name: ReadEverySecond
data.value: {name}, process {process}{container, select, true { in its container} other {}}: read every second
data.comment: The Stats page's words once the program's metrics are read; {process} is its id.
